insights.one_liner: European and Americas arm of Japanese beauty group Kao (John Frieda, Goldwell, Molton Brown), with a hub in Amersfoort and a senior finance role in English.

culture.text: Runs beauty brands in consumer care, salon and luxury, including John Frieda, Biore, Goldwell and Molton Brown.
Main hubs are London, Darmstadt, Amersfoort and Cincinnati; about 3,748 people are on this regional page.
Staff often studied marketing, business, chemistry or economics, with main jobs in operations, sales and marketing.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Parent company Kao, a Japanese maker of personal care and household products, dates back to 1887.
